summary.text: House Democrats are objecting to what they describe as an effort to rewrite or erase American history at the Smithsonian, centered on Lonnie Bunch and his apparent departure. The story remains a single day: everything logged falls on September 9, with nothing before or after, so day-to-day movement cannot be traced. Participation is thin and flat — @RepBynum, @RepJulieJohnson and @RepKweisiMfume each posted once, no retweets, no clear leader. Framing, on that one day, is heritage and continuity rather than institutional independence or funding, captured by Bynum's "you can't understand where we're going if we don't know where we've been." Open: whether it recurs, whether a lead member emerges, and whether the frame widens.
